title: Open-source DWG/DXF route completeness and 3D semantic ceiling
mode: Broader primary-source implementation and consumer-route review
scope: Compare screened DWG/DXF codecs, bare ACIS/ASM parsers, geometry conversion routes, and downstream consumers by exact processing stage.
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 evidence handoff without creating a new finding, implementation subplan, dependency, or routine external gate.
Keep external qualification items J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 advisory and explicitly deferred.

method.kind: Primary project documentation, published route matrices, issue pages, and implementation-contract review
method.mutableSourcePolicy: Mutable branch documentation is capability context only. Any future execution must pin an immutable release/commit, artifact hash, route, version, and profile.
method.evidenceRule: DWG/DXF container decoding, graph/owner association, raw SAT/SAB retention, independent parser acceptance, B-rep validity/analytic semantics, and native application behavior are distinct results.

evidence.observed: The project distinguishes broad DWG read behavior from writer and tool-specific version coverage, notes some advanced R2010+ objects may be skipped, and documents incomplete AcDsPrototype_1b/SAB handling including a brute-force extraction approach in its historical notes.
evidence.limits: Project declarations and NEWS do not establish exact current object semantics, AcDs association completeness, arbitrary SAB geometry, or native acceptance.
evidence.planUse: Use only direction/revision/version/entity-scoped structural comparison; do not treat a solid shell, successful exit status, or DXF emission as modeler evidence.

evidence.observed: The README publishes separate DWG/DXF reader/writer columns by version and exposes notifications in reader examples. Issue #1195 reports 3DSOLID/REGION DXF-writer omissions in a named older release.
evidence.limits: The matrix is not per-entity semantic validation; the old issue is not evidence of current-master behavior; no peer run or sample inspection occurred.
evidence.planUse: Admit only exact operation/version/entity cells and capture diagnostics and per-source-record disposition. Do not infer geometry from document load or counts.

evidence.observed: The DXF library exposes SAT/SAB data inspection and bounded parser/export functionality. Its authoring guide requires an external ACIS-data producer; the renderer documents that ACIS rendering and a 3D rendering engine are unsupported.
evidence.limits: These sources do not establish general ACIS editing, complete B-rep interpretation, arbitrary producer compatibility, or native CAD acceptance.
evidence.planUse: Use for strict DXF structure, exact carrier extraction, or explicitly bounded record checks only.

evidence.observed: These projects expose selected bare SAT/SAB/ASM profiles. Their public contracts separate framing/reference decoding from a supported subset of geometry construction; cq-acis uses CadQuery/OCCT for shape conversion.
evidence.limits: They are not DWG/DXF containers or AcDs ownership readers. Profile coverage is bounded; parser/reference closure does not prove a complete B-rep or correct geometry. Some format-research and kernel lineage is shared.
evidence.planUse: Only pass independently associated raw carriers after signature/version selection. Record parser lineage and keep parser success, kernel validity, and independently authored analytic expectations separate.

evidence.observed: Official sources distinguish the open-source OCCT core exchange formats from separately distributed commercial exchange components, including ACIS SAT/SAB support.
evidence.limits: A stock OCCT or FreeCAD installation does not imply availability of the commercial translator; no local entitlement or execution was checked.
evidence.planUse: Treat any authorized commercial translator as optional license-bound corroboration, not an open-source gate or required dependency.

evidence.observed: The documented DWG route converts to DXF and then uses a selected DXF importer. Current documentation says stock DXF import cannot read ACIS/SAT solids and lists a bounded set of explicit DXF entities.
evidence.limits: Documentation is not execution evidence for any local build, platform, converter, optional workbench, or geometry result.
evidence.planUse: Keep FreeCAD native checks scoped to a pinned converter/importer/platform and supported explicit entity profile. Do not use this route to unblock ACIS/AcDs semantics.

evidence.observed: Added a staged result handoff for container, graph association, raw carrier, independent parser/profile, geometry semantics, and native consumer evidence under existing PAR-07/S8 and consumer owners.
evidence.limits: No production code or test was changed or run. The review does not resolve platform qualification or independent semantic evidence.
evidence.planUse: Use existing generated fast tests per implementation slice; reserve the composed external checkpoint for a payload that matches an admitted candidate profile and has an independent expected-value path.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: keep container decoding, object graph/AcDs association, carrier bytes/profile, bare-carrier parser, B-rep semantics, and application behavior as separate evidence cells.
FreeCAD consumer qualification: restrict the documented converter-to-DXF-to-import route to its supported explicit DXF entity set; it is not ACIS/AcDs semantic evidence.
External validation cadence: use existing generated local fast tests per slice; run composed external routes only when exact profile and independent expected values are available.

planChanges: Reconciled screened repositories by stage rather than headline feature labels: codec/version route, DXF ACIS carrier handling, bare SAT/SAB profile parsing, geometry conversion, and downstream consumer acceptance.
Made explicit that no screened open-source route currently serves as a single end-to-end DWG/AcDs-to-native-B-rep qualification oracle.
Refined existing consumer guidance: documented FreeCAD converter-to-DXF import is useful only for its explicit supported entity subset and cannot qualify ACIS/AcDs semantics.

Specified the readiness handoff from exact container/owner association through carrier profile, independent parser, analytic geometry expectations, and consumer observation; missing external conditions remain non-blocking and self-unblock to local work.
limitations: This is a source/documentation review of screened projects, not an exhaustive census of all open-source CAD projects.
Mutable branch sources were treated as current-source observations, not immutable release guarantees.
No peer binary, package, native application, geometry kernel, or external drawing was run or downloaded.
No external/platform qualification was completed; the six J items remain advisory and non-promoting.
